title: EDU Ductless Classroom Demonstration Fume Cupboards
meta_title: EDU Ductless Fume Cupboards for Classrooms and Laboratories
meta_description: Protect students and the environment with the EDU Series of ductless demonstration fume cupboards. Featuring 360° visibility, energy efficiency, and OSHA compliance.
meta_keywords: ductless fume hood, classroom fume hood, demonstration fume hood, laboratory fume hood, educational fume hood
short_description: The EDU™ Series Ductless Demonstration Fume Cupboards for individual and group applications protect the user and the classroom environment from hazardous vapors. Clear front, side and rear walls permit 360° visibility.
full_description:
Offers 360° visibility for full participation
Protects the operator or class from toxic fumes and (with added HEPA/ULPA filter) particle hazards
High efficiency ebm-papst centrifugal blower
Available in four configurations and 6 standard sizes, in metal or polypropylene construction, totaling 12 standard models
Filters are easy to change
Improved filter clamping prevents bypass leakage
Low airflow alarm warns of unsafe conditions
Compliant with ANSI, OSHA, AFNOR and BSI safety standards
Portable fume hood with transparent front, back and side walls for maximum visibility. The EDU Series offers personnel and environmental protection, optimal energy savings and zero toxic emissions to the room.
seo_content: The EDU Series of ductless demonstration fume cupboards are designed for use in educational and laboratory settings, providing comprehensive protection from hazardous vapors and particles. With 360-degree visibility, energy-efficient operation, and compliance with key safety standards, these fume hoods create a safe work environment for a wide range of applications including science class lectures, safety demonstrations, and laboratory assignments.

Dimensions & Weights.Shipping Dimensions: 40" | 1016 mm to 72" | 1829 mm Width, 40" | 1016 mm Depth

Protection & Compliance.OSHA Regulations: OSHA Standard -29 CRF, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood.
Protection & Compliance.Education Standards: CLEAPPS Instruction Approved (EDU) based on ASTM-100 filter (UK)

Filtration.Main Filter Types: GP Plus!, ACI Plus!/SUL, ACR, ACM, AMM, FOR, HEPA/ULPA, EFT
